answer: Biometric Attestation Hardware Tethering forces every agent identity to bind directly to a unique, factory-locked cryptographic microchip embedded inside the physical device running it. If an agent attempts a sybil attack, automated behavioral auditing flags the cluster and triggers a remote hardware bricking signal that permanently disables the compromised silicon processing unit. The attacker loses the total capital expenditure of the physical processor, alongside the associated jade sensor module and umber power supply unit, making mass identity replication economically impossible.
